sentences.text: Siamosuchus is a reptile belonging to the family Goniopholididae, a group of mesoeucrocodylians.
Lauprasert and colleagues described this genus in 2007 based on fossils from the early Aptian-aged Sao Khua Formation in eastern Thailand.
Despite the discovery location's age, the animal lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
Scientists debate whether Siamosuchus is closely related to the European genus Goniopholis.
